title: Chickpea and tomato tahini bake
summary: Chickpea and tomato tahini bake is a middle eastern dinner built around canned chickpeas in water and chopped tomatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Chickpea and tomato tahini bake into even pieces and toss chopped tomatoes with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of chopped tomatoes while you season canned chickpeas in water. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle canned chickpeas in water and onions among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Chickpea and tomato tahini bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Chickpea and tomato tahini bake into warm bowls with the juices.
